pageTitle: Calculate Your University of San Diego GPA

officialLinks.label: Credit/grading, GPA formula, Pass/Fail, withdrawals, standing, honors

helpIntro: USD uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter semester units and final USD grades to estimate your current and projected GPA.
helpNote: P, I, W, and transferred grades are excluded from the cumulative USD GPA. A failing Pass/Fail outcome affects GPA. Repeat adjustment is not automated because USD applies a special first-10-repeated-units rule.
helpExample: A 3-unit A earns 12.00 grade points; a 3-unit B+ earns 9.99. Together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 and its attempted units count in GPA; this also applies to a failing Pass/Fail outcome.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass; units do not enter the USD GPA.

specialTypes.name: USD course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter USD semester units and the final posted grade.

specialTypes.name: Transferred course
specialTypes.note: Transferred courses count for approved unit credit only and are not calculated into the cumulative USD GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated D/F course
specialTypes.note: USD repeat treatment depends on the student's cumulative repeated-unit history. The first 10 repeated D/F units use the most recent grade; later repetitions count all grades. Registrar adjustment may be required.

repeatPolicy.note: Use the Repeated D/F course type for a repeat scenario and confirm the adjusted cumulative GPA with the Registrar.
